title.zh: Solana基金会推出机构级结算标准Solana DvP，获摩根大通参与设计
title.en: Solana基金会推出机构级结算标准Solana DvP，获摩根大通参与设计

current_state.zh:
Solana基金会推出Solana DvP，这是一项以MIT许可证发布的开源交付对付款（DvP）结算API，面向金融机构。基金会称该项目已完成外部安全审计，已具备真实资金使用条件；摩根大通在其开发过程中就机构结算实践与需求提供了意见。

摩根大通市场数字资产主管Rhodel D'Souza表示，该结算标准属于机构市场参与者所需的“基础性基础设施”，使其能够“在不引入结算风险和对手方敞口的情况下实现规模化运作”。Solana基金会称，该标准旨在以统一方案替代机构此前依赖的定制化智能合约。

Solana DvP支持SPL Token和Token-2022，并支持永久授权、可暂停代币以及Transfer Hooks等扩展功能；任意两方交易对手均可通过银行、托管机构或交易平台等结算代理使用该程序。基金会表示计划进一步加入隐私功能以实现私密、保密的结算，目前正在招募设计合作伙伴和早期参与者，为正式上线做准备。
current_state.en: The Solana Foundation launched Solana DvP, an MIT-licensed open-source delivery-versus-payment settlement API for financial institutions, developed with J.P. Morgan's input on institutional settlement practices and already externally audited for real-funds use.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Solana Foundation launched Solana DvP, an MIT-licensed open-source delivery-versus-payment settlement API for financial institutions, developed with J.P. Morgan's input on institutional settlement practices and already externally audited for real-funds use.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Solana Foundation launched Solana DvP, an MIT-licensed open-source delivery-versus-payment settlement API for financial institutions, developed with J.P. Morgan's input on institutional settlement practices and already externally audited for real-funds use.
updates.background_zh: 交付对付款（DvP）是证券结算的基础机制，确保资产与现金同时转移，从而消除本金风险；传统市场中该流程需经过清算机构、存托机构和托管机构等多个环节，结算可能需要数天。2025年6月，Chainlink、摩根大通的Kinexys与Ondo Finance完成了一项跨链DvP试点，涉及Ondo的代币化美国国债基金，并通过Kinexys完成付款。
updates.background_en: Delivery versus payment is a standard securities settlement mechanism in which the transfer of assets and the corresponding payment occur simultaneously, removing principal risk; in traditional markets the process runs through clearing houses, depositories and custodians and can take days. In June 2025, Chainlink, JPMorgan's Kinexys and Ondo Finance completed a cross-chain DvP pilot involving Ondo's tokenized US Treasury fund with payment through Kinexys.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该标准针对的是Solana上代币化现实世界资产的结算环节，其传导路径主要通过机构代币化场所和SPL Token/Token-2022发行体系，而非直接作用于现货交易。由于基金会仍在招募设计合作伙伴、尚未公布已上线的实际部署，短期影响主要限于市场对Solana未来代币化资产结算活动的预期。
updates.market_impact_en: The standard targets the settlement leg of tokenized real-world assets on Solana, so its transmission path runs through institutional tokenization venues and the SPL Token/Token-2022 issuance stack rather than through spot trading directly. Because the foundation is still recruiting design partners and has not announced live deployments, any near-term effect is limited to expectations around future tokenized-asset settlement activity on Solana.
